security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; script-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Mods for Longshot and Hookshot, with one size table for all of them
bundle.longDescription: Point it at your Longshot or Hookshot folder (or at the game's files and an emulator's mods folder) and drop mods into the mods folder: it turns mods on and off and keeps one resource size table for every mod that is on.
